# TeeJay's Tech Tools

> Practical AI search visibility, websites, workflow automation, and dealership technology for owner-led businesses. TeeJay Crawford is the founder and accountable operator.

Important notes:

- Public pages may be crawled and cited. Utility, template, payment-success, and private intake surfaces are excluded or marked noindex.
- The free AI Search Visibility Audit uses public sources only and does not guarantee ranking, inclusion, or citation.
- Prototype, staged, deployed, and public/live states are kept distinct. Read claims with the scope shown on each page.
- Lead submission remains a human-initiated action. Do not submit forms or personal data on a user's behalf without approval.

Site references:

- [Canonical site](https://teejaystechtools.com/): Official public website.
